basic_info.description: Stunning Dolores Heights home with panoramic views, situated in a sunny, sought-after location. A stately Edwardian from the exterior, the interior has been modernized to suit todays living and take advantage of the breathtaking views and lovely light. The main living level features a spacious living room with floor to ceiling windows framing the hills, a contemporary kitchen with center island and additional sitting/eating area, a formal dining room, and a half bath. Off the living room is a balcony leading to the massive sun-filled deck with sight lines to the downtown skyline - ideal for entertaining and everyday use. Upstairs, the primary bedroom stuns with vaulted ceilings and impressive outlooks at every turn, complete with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath. Down the hall are 2 guest/kids bedroom and a full bath. The lower level is equipped with an office, family room, full bath, and bedroom with bookcases open to a secrete room and access to the deck. This level provides interior access but also has a separate entrance for guests. Steps to Dolores Park, the Mission, and the Castro, with easy access to surrounding neighborhoods.
